title: Weyaxi Releases 1,000 RL Environments for Terminal Agents
summary:
The new TermGrade dataset establishes an open source framework for improving how AI models execute commands in a terminal. Weyaxi and @aiand_ released 1,000 executable reinforcement learning (RL) environments that were verified through execution and graded against 6 different models, along with 36,000 trajectories including failed attempts and the RL training recipe.

Training a gemma-4-31B-it model on tasks it solved 50% of the time resulted in a 3.1 point increase on the Terminal-Bench 2.1 benchmark. The project also includes documentation on the construction and evaluation of the environments to provide a transparent resource for developers building agents that operate via command line interfaces.
